negative_results.name: logistic_label_permutation
negative_results.reason: Training labels were permuted inside each fit fold. A score near the full logistic model would indicate leakage.

negative_results.name: moe_static_calibrated
negative_results.reason: Inner-OOF temperature and 20x logit bias did not reduce outer-fold sampled Brier versus the uncalibrated static mixture.

report_revision: Markdown reading section regenerated from the saved numeric payload after the report renderer was extended. Candidate metrics were not refit.
selection_note: Primary hyperparameters are the protocol values. Grids and the top-three pairwise follow-up are sensitivity checks on the same folds, not a held-out confirmation and not a public-validation search.
